$comment: Short cards for secondary projects. Facts verified against the repos on 2026-11-01. Private repos have no link.

items.title: Interview Gym
items.what: A trainer I built for my own interview preparation: algorithm patterns with Python running in the browser, behavioral and system-design practice, a 14-day plan.
items.detail: A validator script runs every reference solution against its tests in CPython (at least 4 tests per exercise) before content changes go in.
items.numbers: 12 patterns · 36 coding exercises with tests · 377 curated practice problems · 57 behavioral questions · 35 system-design cases

items.title: babyloop
items.what: A mobile app for a family’s baby-sleep routine, built for home use first: one-tap events and the next sleep time.
items.detail: Sleep calculations exist twice — a Python core and an offline TypeScript port — and the same JSON cases run in pytest and Jest to prove they agree. A test computes colour contrast for the specified text/background pairs in every theme.
items.numbers: Design system v1 in 4 parts · light, dark and a dedicated night theme
